          photography, film, design, technology and marketing work together
          instead of in isolation. Eighteen years on, that ecosystem is the
          business: photographers, filmmakers, editors, designers, developers,
          strategists and marketers under one roof, so nothing is lost between

fields.default: Are you a photography studio or an agency?

fields.label: Both, and that's the point. Smashbox began in 2008 …
fields.default: Both, and that's the point. Smashbox began in 2008 as a commercial photography and film company and now runs three divisions — Capture (photography and film), Create (branding, design, websites, motion) and Connect (influencer marketing and PR). Most clients arrive for one and end up using all three.

fields.label: Can you take a launch end to end?

fields.default: That is the way we prefer to work. Strategy, identity, packaging, the photography and film, the website, the social creative, then the influencer and PR push — one team, one timeline, one set of objectives, instead of four suppliers pointing at each other.

fields.label: It depends on scope — the number of SKUs, the styli…
fields.default: It depends on scope — the number of SKUs, the styling involved, studio or location, how much design and development sits around it, and the size of the campaign. Send a brief and you'll have a firm number, not an estimate.

fields.label: How long does the work take?
fields.default: How long does the work take?

fields.label: Photography selects reach you within 48 hours of th…
fields.default: Photography selects reach you within 48 hours of the shoot and retouched files in five to seven working days. Films take two to three weeks including revisions. Identity work runs three to five weeks, websites four to eight depending on scale, and campaigns are scheduled around your launch date.

fields.label: Regularly. Mumbai and the rest of Maharashtra are r…
fields.default: Regularly. Mumbai and the rest of Maharashtra are routine, and we've shot factories, hotels and properties across India. Travel and logistics are quoted separately and transparently.

fields.default: Yes. Food styling, prop sourcing, set building, model casting, hair and makeup are arranged by our producer, and creator and celebrity partnerships are sourced and negotiated by the Connect team. You approve the mood board and the creator list before anything is booked.

fields.label: Please do. We shoot tethered to a large monitor so …
fields.default: Please do. We shoot tethered to a large monitor so you can approve frames as they happen. If you can't be there, we run the same review over a live link.

fields.label: Still stuck on something? Get the studio's monthly …
fields.default: Still stuck on something? Get the studio's monthly note — new work, lighting and design breakdowns, campaign numbers and the occasional honest post-mortem.
